item.title: Gumball goes off the rails in season 2's wacky new trailer
item.description: Catch the new "Gumball" season 2 trailer! Expect chaotic adventures, hilarious moments and a new animation style for Elmore's world.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Dense fog in patches overnight into tomorrow morning
item.description: Count on another round of fog overnight into tomorrow morning. It will be dense in patches. Your morning temperatures will start out in the 30s and 40s and then rise to the low 50s to the mid 60s in the afternoon with most areas seeing the sunshine.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: SF residents spent over $800K on private guards, blame city for worsening conditions
item.description: In San Francisco, a group of residents is having to pay for private security guards, as they say conditions in their area have deteriorated after a number of city services, like shelters, have opened in the area.

item.title: Meet 'Ella McCay,' the latest big screen muse of Oscar winner James L. Brooks
item.description: Writer/director James L. Brooks introduces us to "Ella McCay" in a film that tells the story of a smart, ambitious young woman dealing with lots of big life issues. It also brings actress Emma Mackey into the spotlight.

item.title: Bub's Bakery reimagines baked goods with allergy-free recipes
item.description: We're taking you to a bakery that's catering to everyone, and that's because they don't serve anything with the top nine allergens.

item.title: Immigration class-action lawsuit against Sec. Noem, DOJ heard in San Jose federal court
item.description: The policy implemented this year allows ICE to detain people, who have not been determined to be a danger to the community or a threat to flee, at check-in appointments and at immigration court. The class-action lawsuit seeks to end this policy.

item.title: Grammy-nominated opera singer Jubilant Sykes found killed in California home; son in custody
item.description: A 31-year-old man was taken into custody after his father, Jubilant Sykes, a Grammy-nominated opera singer, was found dead inside a Southern California home.

item.title: On the frontlines of the fight for a bird-friendly NYC
item.description: Founded in 1997, Project Safe Flight began as a group of volunteers who monitored building collisions in lower Manhattan.

item.title: In-N-Out removes number 67 from order system due to viral 6-7 trend
item.description: In-N-Out has reportedly kicked 67 out of its order system because of the viral 6-7 trend.

item.title: Attorney General Rob Bonta reportedly reconsidering run for California governor
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta is reportedly exploring a run for California governor, after previously saying he would not be going for the job.
